item.title: Pavago: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
item.skills: Analytics, CMS Development, CRM, Cross-Browser Development, Bug Tracking, CRM Systems, SEO, Analytics Tools, CRM Integration, and Data Visualization
item.description:
Headquarters: Albania
URL: http://pavago.co

Description

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

item.title: Terac: Product Marketing Managers: GTM Brief Review for Bike Repair Tool
item.skills: Analytics, Google Analytics, Monitoring and Analytics, Predictive Analytics, Cyber Security, Endpoint Security, Performance Monitoring, Analytics Tools, Ecommerce Web Development, and Ecommerce Management
item.description:
Headquarters: Afghanistan
URL: http://terac.com

What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on go-to-market strategies tailored to independent retail operations. Specifically, we are evaluating a new appointment management tool designed for independent bicycle repair shops. This research helps us refine our initial product positioning and identify hidden risks before launch.

How It Works

You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan. Next, you will write a short report that clearly separates unsubstantiated assumptions from hard evidence. Finally, you will recommend one low-cost validation step to test our riskiest assumption without conducting new market outreach.

Who This Is For

We welcome Product Marketing Managers, GTM Strategists, and early-stage Product Managers with experience in retail software or small business tools. Candidates should have a strong grasp of market validation techniques and startup strategy. Familiarity with independent bike shops or local service businesses is a strong plus, though not strictly required.

What You'll Do

  • Read and evaluate a short go-to-market strategy brief for a bike shop appointment tool

  • Identify and separate unproven assumptions from backed evidence within the document

  • Write a concise written report summarizing your strategic findings

  • Propose one cheap, actionable validation step to test the core strategy

Who Should Apply

  • Professional experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, or product management

  • Strong analytical skills for evaluating business plans and marketing briefs

  • Ability to communicate strategic feedback clearly in a written format

  • Familiarity with retail operations or local service business software is a plus

Compensation

$45 one-time

 

Ready to participate?

Start your paid interview now

 

About Terac

Terac is building the world's largest pool of vetted human experts for AI. Researchers, AI labs, and product teams use Terac to recruit, screen, and pay study participants across industries, languages, and skill sets.

 

Learn more at terac.com or on YouTube at @jointerac.

item.title: CapsLock: Creative Marketing Project Coordinator
item.skills: Productivity Software, Project Management, Software Support, Software Upgrades, SaaS, Hardware/Software Support, HR Software, Construction & Engineering Project Management, and Supply Chain & Logistic Project Management
item.description:
Headquarters: Tirana, Remote, Albania
URL: http://capslock.global

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.


At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.


﻿Role overview 


Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.

You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.

If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.


Responsibilities


Task & Pipeline Management

  • Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
  • Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
  • Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
  • Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage


Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up

  • Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
  • Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
  • Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
  • Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed


Quality Control

  • Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
  • Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
  • Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
  • Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals


Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
  • Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
  • Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards


Process Improvement & AI

  • Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
  • Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
  • Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes


Creative Collaboration

  • Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
  • Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
  • Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

Must-Have Skills

  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
  • Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
  • Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
  • Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
  • Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content


Technical Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
  • Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
  • Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
  • Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher


Soft Skills

  • Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
  • Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines
  • Clear, professional communicator
  • Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team
  • Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas


What we offer


  • Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
  • Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/capslock-creative-marketing-project-coordinator

item.title: WeVote: Managing Editor (Volunteer)
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: http://wevote.us

Help inform and empower millions of voters.

WeVote is a nonpartisan civic technology nonprofit building tools that help voters make informed decisions and participate in democracy. As a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee, we're creating digital solutions that improve voter engagement and access to trustworthy election information.

We're seeking a Managing Editor to lead the day-to-day editorial operations of WeVote's content programs, including our blog, newsletters, and voter education initiatives. This volunteer leadership role is ideal for an experienced editor, journalist, or content leader who is passionate about civic engagement and wants to make a meaningful impact through high-quality, nonpartisan journalism.

What You'll Do

✅ Manage the editorial calendar and publication workflow for blogs, newsletters, and voter education content

✅ Edit, review, and publish content that meets high standards for accuracy, clarity, and nonpartisan integrity

✅ Lead and mentor a team of volunteer writers, researchers, and content contributors

✅ Coordinate content assignments, deadlines, and production schedules

✅ Maintain editorial guidelines, style standards, and fact-checking processes

✅ Collaborate with product, communications, marketing, and political data teams to identify and develop compelling content opportunities

✅ Help grow audience engagement through clear, informative, and impactful storytelling

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in editing, journalism, content strategy, publishing, communications, or a related field
  • Strong copyediting, proofreading, and content development skills
  • Experience managing editorial workflows and publication schedules
  • Ability to coach writers and provide constructive editorial feedback
  • Familiarity with digital publishing platforms, newsletters, and CMS tools
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills
  • Commitment to nonpartisan voter education and civic engagement
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote, volunteer-driven environment

Why Join WeVote?

  • Help strengthen democracy through voter education and civic technology
  • Lead mission-driven editorial initiatives with national impact
  • Collaborate with passionate professionals across journalism, technology, product, and communications
  • Expand your leadership and editorial management experience
  • Build your portfolio while contributing to an innovative nonprofit organization

Position Details

Location: Remote (U.S.-based volunteers preferred)

Time Commitment: Approximately 5-10 hours per week

Compensation: Volunteer Position

About WeVote

WeVote is a nonpartisan, nonprofit civic technology organization dedicated to helping voters make informed choices. Through innovative digital tools, trusted voter information, and community engagement, we work to increase participation in every election.

Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you!!

item.title: WeVote: Newsletter Team Co-Lead
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: http://wevote.us

* Fraud and phishing warning * 

Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you

*About WeVote*
WeVote is a 100% volunteer-powered, nonpartisan nonprofit that uses technology to help voters make informed decisions. With 250+ active volunteers and a national reach—we prove grassroots, mission-first civic tech can have real impact.

Join the WeVote Movement

WeVote has an open volunteer position for a Newsletter Team Co-Lead, for 2 hours or more per week. You are an experienced professional with a passion for helping America navigate our current political environment. This is an opportunity to work remotely with our active team to help us get ready for multiple upcoming elections. Our ideal volunteer is passionate about politics and excited to use technology to educate voters and increase voter turnout. You’ll also gain valuable technical skills, have opportunities for leadership development, and expand your personal and professional network.

About Us

WeVote is a nonpartisan get-out-the-vote nonprofit startup and a celebrated Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. WeVote is a movement of over 180 active passionate, part-time volunteers (starting with the founders) who build mobile technologies that will touch and mobilize millions of voters on Election Day. We believe that many voters are busy, distracted, and impatient. We have a goal of providing a positive voting experience that helps people decide how to vote. More information at https://WeVote.US or @WeVote on X.

What You'll Do

  • Assemble, edit, and get reviewed our regular newsletter (in Mailchimp). We send a public newsletter approximately once per month to ~5,000 subscribers, and an internal newsletter once per month to ~1,200 current and former volunteers
  • Work with our 15+ person marketing team, including graphic artists, writers, videographers, and political data managers
  • Inspire other volunteers to craft text, photos, and images for the newsletter
  • Work within WeVote content guidelines, leverage our existing assets (Canva), and create new assets

Who you are: Must haves.

  • You want to work with an established and successful team. You are committed to strengthening American Democracy.
  • You are striving for personal excellence, and want to do meaningful work that will make a difference.
  • 2+ hours per week during our core team hours M-F 8 a.m. - 6 p.m.
  • A willingness to work with and support other volunteers.
  • You agree with WeVote’s Core Values.
  • We are seeking a marketing perfectionist; someone who loves the iteration process, someone who strives for artistry in their deliverables.

How to apply:

Submit your resume (at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply/) and include a brief note/cover letter to why you are interested in WeVote and helping our mission.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wevote-newsletter-team-co-lead
